title: French Basics
description: Essential French greetings, vocabulary and beginner grammar

questions.question: How do you say 'Hello' in French?
questions.explanation: Bonjour is the standard French greeting, used from morning until evening. It literally means 'good day'.

questions.question: What does 'Merci' mean?
questions.explanation: Merci means 'thank you'. To be more emphatic you can say 'merci beaucoup' (thank you very much).

questions.question: Which greeting would you use in the evening?
questions.explanation: Bonsoir is used when greeting someone in the evening. 'Bonne nuit' is only said when parting for bed, and 'bon matin' is not standard French.

questions.question: What is the French word for 'water'?
questions.explanation: Water is 'l'eau' (eau is a feminine noun, so it takes 'la', shortened to l' before a vowel). Le pain is bread, le lait is milk and le vin is wine.

questions.question: How do you say 'My name is...' in French?
questions.explanation: Je m'appelle... literally means 'I call myself...' and is the usual way to introduce yourself. 'Tu t'appelles...' means 'your name is...'.

questions.question: What does 'S'il vous plaît' mean?
questions.explanation: S'il vous plaît means 'please' in formal or plural address. With someone you know well you would say 's'il te plaît'.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: 'Je ___ étudiant.'
questions.explanation: The verb être (to be) is conjugated 'je suis' in the first person singular. 'Tu es', 'il est' and 'nous sommes' are the other forms shown.

questions.question: Which definite article goes before a feminine singular noun?
questions.explanation: Feminine singular nouns take 'la', as in 'la table'. Masculine singular nouns take 'le' and all plural nouns take 'les'.

questions.question: What does 'Comment ça va ?' mean?
questions.explanation: Comment ça va ? means 'How are you?' or 'How's it going?'. A common reply is 'Ça va bien, merci' (I'm well, thank you).

questions.question: How do you say 'Goodbye' in French?
questions.explanation: Au revoir is the standard way to say goodbye. 'Bienvenue' means welcome and 'de rien' means you're welcome.
